Definition
[Horoball and horosphere] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0198 1. ch31:31.12\group Hyperbolic cusps

A horoball is the intersection of the disk model with a Euclidean ball tangent to its ideal boundary; its boundary is a horosphere. In the upper half-space model horoballs are also regions $\{ x_n\ge c\} $.
